summary: This report provides an update on the results of the marketing process for 50 Wilson Heights Boulevard, 705 Warden Avenue and 777 Victoria Park Avenue. In October, CBRE, on behalf of the Housing Secretariat and CreateTO, launched a marketing process for the three (3) sites which culminated in bid submissions on December 10, 2019. Since then, the teams have analysed the bids, interviewed all bidders, asked for and received clarifications, scored them. Shortlisted bidders have been sent further questions due back on January 22, 2020. A supplementary report will be submitted to the Board to provide further updates on this process. The zoning by-law amendment for 777 Victoria Park has been approved and the draft plan conditions and zoning by-law amendments for 50 Wilson Heights and 705 Warden are expected to be submitted to the Planning and Housing Committee in February 2020.
decided: The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Approved the recommended proponents identified in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 24, 2020) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO, for the development of Housing Now projects at each of 50 Wilson Heights Boulevard and 777 Victoria Park Avenue and directed the Chief Executive Officer to forward to the City's Deputy City Manager, Corporate Services and the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer for consideration and to approve any lease, transfer and other property transactions with the selected proponent. 2. Directed the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO, once the City approvals in Part 1 above have been obtained, to negotiate in conjunction with the City Solicitor, the final documents for the transaction with each proponent and report back to the Board of Directors of CreateTO when management has reached an agreement. 3. Directed the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO to work with the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, to establish a reserve fund into which net contributions received from the selected proponents will be deposited and from which any required City contributions will be paid in order to complete the above transactions. 4.
